snippet.title: The Demon Lord is New in Town! - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Moments before his defeat, the demon lord takes over the body of his attacker. Now human, with no memories or powers, Van and his subordinate, Aira, move to a small town and begin life anew with a cast of beautiful and quirky characters.
